description: This file defines models and a fetcher for OECD House Price Index data, including query parameter validation, data extraction from OECD API, and data transformation.

classes.name: OECDHousePriceIndexQueryParams
classes.description: Model for OECD House Price Index query parameters with validation.

classes.name: OECDHousePriceIndexData
classes.description: Data model for OECD House Price Index data.

classes.name: OECDHousePriceIndexFetcher
classes.description: Fetcher class to retrieve and process OECD House Price Index data.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Transforms input parameters into a validated query object, setting default start and end dates.

methods.name: extract_data
methods.description: Fetches data from OECD API, processes CSV response, and returns list of data records.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Converts raw data into data model instances.
